question: Which customer segment had the most customers churn in 2025, and who was that segment's top customer by completed revenue in 2025? Give the customer's ID, name and 2025 completed revenue.

sql_attempts.sql: WITH churned_segments AS (SELECT c.segment, COUNT(*) AS churn_count FROM customers AS c WHERE c.churn_date >= '2025-01-01' AND c.churn_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY churn_count DESC LIMIT 1), top_customer AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS rev FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE c.segment = (SELECT segment FROM churned_segments) AND o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT cs.segment, tc.customer_id, tc.customer_name, tc.rev AS customer_revenue FROM churned_segments AS cs CROSS JOIN top_customer AS tc
